title: Litoral southeastern inner joined small roof
visualBrief: Complete original small numerical roof body 6792W3W4+WR8H~6792W3W4+WR5R, retaining every source corner. The two overlapping WR8H/WR5Rsource observations are one exact united exterior roof volume; their shared2.4759397497m²area is represented once, with no separate-room identity. Three other original source outlines remain whole. Exact historic use, appearance, roof profile and2023condition unverified; this intrinsic member does not complete the whole prison. Original Google v3 full-precision WKT and source archive hash retained under selected ODbL. All source ranks 0.6782/0.6571 are below0.780tile ranking threshold; no tile80%-precision or per-building accuracy probability. The joined roof has no invented combined confidence score. No qualified original2023numeric height observation exists. Nominal3.5m height will be an original visualization estimate with5m height allowance, not measured height, a floor census or verified2023presence. Retain15m horizontal modeling allowance. Own original field precedes floors/mainsections; no field fitting or relocation. All appearance imagery unused, Qualla first unrelated portrait excluded. Entire complete source-set difference retained. These are whole small source roof bodies with no accepted-body overlap, not boundary slivers or yards. Original individual source ranks 0.6782/0.6571 are below0.780tile ranking threshold; no tile80%-precision or per-building probability. No combined confidence invented. Original15m horizontal allowance is a modeling estimate, not measured survey error. No qualified original2023numeric height observation exists. Nominal3.5m above-floor heights with5m allowances are explicit original visualization estimates, not observations or verified2023presence. No floor census, surveyed roof section, ownership or exact historic condition is claimed. Initial local0.25m plinth chosen after own original field and before geometry; no accepted adjacent source overlaps, so no neighboring absolute-floor transfer or common surveyed datum claimed. Original frame/field/floor/mainsections frozen before geometry and first render; no masks, flattening, cutouts, fitted heights or relocation. Whole small closed-volume walls/roof/foundation retained at all four authored detail levels. Facade opening/door/bar/canopy census, roof membrane/parapet, stucco/concrete/metal finish and physical use remain original estimates. No source-based room identity or interiors. All source imagery, photographs, plans, figures and map pixels unused. Qualla first one unrelated public-domain portrait excluded. Original WKT/archive hash and original numeric height/presence samples retained. No old member geometry, fields, frames, floors or QA changed. Whole prison remains unfinished. Original source footprint inference and nominal height/section controls are not survey.
